STYLE2: A warm, naturally lit full-bleed square illustration rendered in a soft painterly 3D style with rich, true-to-life colors and a golden-hour quality of light — warm backlighting (contre-jour) glowing from just behind or beside the subject, wrapping a soft warm amber-yellow rim of light along its edges and haloing gently through any translucent or fine details, paired with soft, evenly diffused fill light so the front of the subject stays clearly visible, well-exposed and richly colored rather than silhouetted. The overall palette should read noticeably warmer and more saturated toward golden yellow and amber than neutral daylight — a true late-afternoon sunlight feel — while never collapsing into a flat orange-and-purple cinematic tone map and never looking desaturated or muted. Camera: a three-quarter elevated medium close-up, framed so the subject and any paired objects are large and prominent in the square canvas, nothing cropped awkwardly at any edge. The setting described in the prompt must be clearly visible and recognizable around and behind the subject, with its key elements readable — never replaced by an empty wall, a plain studio backdrop or an abstract out-of-focus haze; only the farthest distance may soften gently into warm light blooms for depth. Rendered with crisp, sharp-focus detail throughout and a premium level of surface texture — fabric weave, fur strands, material sheen, glaze, all clearly readable but never overloaded with tiny clutter. Square 1:1 composition, no watermark, no logo.
